meta.title: InstaDown - Instagram Photo & Reels Downloader | Free Instagram Saver
meta.description: Download Instagram photos, reels, and carousel posts for free. Just paste the URL to save original high-quality media. No sign-up required.
meta.ogDescription: Paste an Instagram post URL to download photos and reels for free. No sign-up required!

hero.subtitle: Paste an Instagram post URL to download photos and videos for free.

howToUse.title: How to Use
howToUse.step1Desc: Tap the share button on an Instagram post and copy the link.
howToUse.step2Desc: Paste the copied URL into the input field above and click Download.
howToUse.step3Desc: Click the download button on the photo or video you want to save.

items.question: How do I download Instagram photos?
items.answer: Copy the link of the Instagram post you want to save by tapping the share button. Paste the URL into the InstaDown input field and click Download to save the original high-quality photo.

items.question: Can I download Instagram Reels videos?
items.answer: Yes, you can download Instagram Reels videos. Simply copy the Reels post URL and paste it to save the video in MP4 format.

items.question: Can I save carousel posts with multiple photos?
items.answer: Yes, you can download all photos and videos from carousel (slideshow) posts individually or save them all at once with the 'Download All' button.

items.question: Is this Instagram download service free?
items.answer: Yes, InstaDown is completely free. You can use it without signing up or installing any app, with no download limits.

items.question: Can I download posts from private accounts?
items.answer: No, only posts from public accounts can be downloaded. Posts from private accounts are only visible to their followers and cannot be downloaded.

items.question: What is the quality of downloaded photos?
items.answer: Photos are downloaded in their original resolution as uploaded to Instagram. You get the highest quality images without any compression.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: InstaDown ("Service") values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information in accordance with applicable laws. This Privacy Policy explains what information is collected when you use the Service and how it is used.
privacy.section1Content:
Our Service does not require account registration and collects minimal information.

- Instagram URLs submitted by users: These are temporarily processed for media extraction and are not stored.
- Automatically collected information: Basic information such as IP address, browser type, and access time may be recorded in server logs for service operation.
- Cookies: We may use cookies to enhance your experience and to serve advertisements.
privacy.section2Content:
Collected information is used only for the following purposes:

- Providing the Instagram media download service
- Improving service quality and fixing errors
- Analyzing service usage statistics
- Serving personalized advertisements (Google AdSense)
privacy.section3Content:
This Service may use the following third-party services, each governed by their own privacy policies:

- Google AdSense: Uses cookies to serve personalized advertisements. For more information, see Google's Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy).
- Google Analytics: May be used for analyzing service usage statistics.
- Vercel: Used for hosting and delivering the Service.
privacy.section4Content: This Service does not store Instagram URLs submitted by users. URLs are discarded immediately after media extraction is complete. Server logs are retained for up to 90 days for security and service improvement purposes, after which they are automatically deleted.
privacy.section5Content: You can change or delete cookie settings at any time through your browser settings. You may also refuse cookie collection. However, refusing cookies may limit some features of the Service.
privacy.section6Content: This Service does not intentionally collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If we become aware that a child under 13 has provided personal information, we will promptly delete such information.
privacy.section7Content: This Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect changes in laws or the Service. Any changes will be posted on this page.
privacy.section8Content:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: support@instadownload.me
